headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains to over eight-month highs; markets are closed today for a holiday.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 12 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to reach their highest levels in over eight months.
Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 have surged over 6% in the past five trading sessions.
India VIX has increased by 18% in the last three weeks and 68% over 47 days.
whatHappening: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) cleared Advent International's Rs 3,150 crore investment in Yatharth Hospital.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed companies climbed to a record 19.5% in Q2FY27.
Union Minister Piyush Goyal indicated European carmakers may establish manufacturing facilities in India soon.
India is holding talks with Russia and Ukraine on Black Sea food corridors, according to the Ministry of External Affairs.
summary: Indian stock markets remain closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada and are scheduled to reopen on Thursday, 12 November. In the last session, the Sensex and Nifty extended their rally to hit eight-month highs. Key corporate developments include CCI approval for Advent International's investment in Yatharth Hospital.
